image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a Blue Monkey (Cercopithecus mitis), a species of guenon. The monkey is seated on rocky terrain, facing slightly left. It features a distinctive bare face with a bluish-grey tint, dark fur on the crown and back, a white chest ruff, and orange-brown fur on the lower abdomen. Its hands are clasped together near its chest. The background consists of out-of-focus rocks.
